patterns.note: The Google Doodle on the homepage is a highly dynamic, illustrative animation that continuously evolves, transforming the static logo into a playful, interactive element.
Interior pages utilize a full-width, section-based layout with generous vertical padding, often alternating between text-left/image-right content blocks to create visual interest and clear hierarchy.
Strategic use of Google's primary blue for all calls to action and interactive elements, providing clear visual cues against a predominantly white and light grey background.
An extensive, multi-column utility footer is present on interior pages, organizing a large number of links into logical categories for comprehensive site navigation.

technique_notes: The Google Doodle on the homepage employs complex CSS keyframe animations to create a fluid, evolving illustration that gives the impression of a living, dynamic graphic. This effect is likely achieved by animating multiple SVG or image layers with varying delays and transformations.

Sections on interior pages are designed to reveal content as the user scrolls, likely using a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation for elements as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clean sans-serif, moderately large (~2-3x body text) with a modern, approachable feel; body text is highly readable and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., search bar, buttons, cards), providing a soft, friendly touch without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced on interior pages with generous vertical padding between sections, creating an airy feel, while the homepage is extremely minimal and centered.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly dynamic and illustrative Google Doodle on the homepage, which transforms an otherwise minimal search interface into a canvas for creative, evolving animation. This playful yet sophisticated motion design is a signature element that sets it apart.
